of.needed: whether the Traefik static configuration file (YAML/TOML) sets experimental.http3

consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if the removed `experimental.http3` configuration option is present in the static configuration.

assertion.statement: HTTP3: In v3, HTTP/3 is no longer an experimental feature

evidence.locator: L125-L149 (Migration Guide: From v2 to v3 › Static configuration › Experimental Configuration › HTTP3)
evidence.excerpt:
#### HTTP3

In v3, HTTP/3 is no longer an experimental feature.
It can be enabled on entry points without the associated `experimental.http3` option, which is now removed.
It is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start.

??? example "An example usage of v2 Experimental `http3` option"

    ```yaml tab="File (YAML)"
    experimental:
      http3: true
    ```

    ```toml tab="File (TOML)"
    [experimental]
        http3=true
    ```

    ```bash tab="CLI"
    --experimental.http3=true
    ```
